payout_quote: Palm Beach Research Center (official palmbeachresearch.com study page): 'May receive compensation up to $1,100 for inconvenience and travel.' Other official pages: obstructive sleep apnea study 'compensation up to $1,410 for inconvenience and travel'; NextCOVE COVID vaccine study 'Receive compensation up to $975 for inconvenience and travel'. (Note: several older study pages are marked archived - e.g. TRIUMPH $3,800, Zealand $2,800, UTI $250 - and were NOT used here.)
steps: Open Palm Beach Research Center's official study page and confirm the study is currently enrolling (e.g. the flu + COVID-19 combo vaccine study for seniors aged 65-85).
Check the requirements: e.g. seniors 65-85, healthy or with stable medical condition, able to follow instructions and return for follow-up visits, BMI 18-33.
Complete the questionnaire on the official page to submit your information for the current study.
The study doctor and staff will review additional eligibility criteria with you; pass medical screening (not everyone qualifies).
Participate in the study; receive study-related medical care, lab tests, and procedures at no cost; receive compensation up to the stated amount (e.g. $1,100).
catches: You must meet the study's medical eligibility criteria and pass screening; not everyone qualifies (e.g. the vaccine study requires age 65-85 and BMI 18-33).
All amounts are 'up to' ceilings 'for inconvenience and travel'; actual pay depends on study completion.
The study evaluates an investigational flu/COVID-19 combo vaccine with real medical risks and side effects.
Expect a real time commitment: screening plus multiple on-site clinic visits in West Palm Beach; the $1,100 ceiling pays only for completing the study course.
Studies are on-site in West Palm Beach, Florida - you must be able to attend clinic visits.
Older study pages (TRIUMPH, Zealand, UTI) are archived and no longer active; amounts from archived studies were excluded.
The official listing does not state the exact visit schedule or visit count, so the total time above is an estimate — the actual time commitment could be higher.
biggest_catch: You must qualify for and attend an on-site study in West Palm Beach, Florida; compensation is an 'up to' ceiling for inconvenience and travel tied to completing the study, and the investigational product carries real medical risks.
eligibility: Study-specific: e.g. flu+COVID combo vaccine study requires age 65-85, healthy or stable medical condition, able to follow study instructions, BMI 18-33; additional criteria reviewed by study staff.
timing: Compensation is paid for completing the study; study-related medical care, lab tests, and procedures at no cost.
